market.title: Gwinnett and Rockdale County: September 2026 at a glance
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: The median listing price in Gwinnett County was $449,945 in September 2026, about flat from a year earlier, or about $183 per square foot.
Counting pending sales, Rockdale County had 674 total listings in September 2026, with a pending ratio of about 0.33. The median listed home was about 2,001 square feet.
The simple version for Gwinnett and Rockdale County: buyers have more homes to compare than they did a year ago, so pricing and condition matter more than ever.

rotatingFeatures.label: HOMEOWNER / SEASONAL HOME TIP
rotatingFeatures.title: Dust the Ceiling Fans Before Switching Seasons
paragraphs: Ceiling fan blades collect dust quietly, then send it flying the first time you turn them on high. Dusting ceiling fan blades is on UGA Extension's seasonal home checklist.
items: Turn the fan off and let it stop completely.
Slide an old pillowcase over each blade and wipe as you pull it back, so the dust stays inside.
Use a sturdy step stool, not a chair.
rotatingFeatures.closing: The pillowcase trick keeps the dust off the couch and off you.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: UGA Cooperative Extension, Home Maintenance Checklist (C1082).
